d: A man runs when Deputies spot his meth. A K9 unit tracks men running on a roof. A couple exits a stolen car.
A less lethal shotgun is used. A theft victim throws a tamale. A probation search uncovers drug activity.
A woman assaults her stepfather with a knife after he refuses to take her to the hospital for spider bites.
Officers in Southern California check in with a driver parked in a known drug hotbed.
A deputy aids a man who's fearful of his wife when she drinks.
An out-of-control woman needs to be subdued. A car is seen driving backwards on a one-way street.
Deputies assist an injured woman who vows revenge on her male attackers.
A citizen chases a beer theft suspect. A couple fights over property. Deputy Kent Mundell finds a meth lab.
A Taser ends a standoff on a park bench. A runner ditches his drugs. A suspect brings a knife to a burglary.
A woman claims a man abused her then put a curse on her.
Officers respond to a shoplifting call at a local thrift store.
Two suspects lead Officers on a chase. An Officer discovers two men have warrants after a traffic stop.
A suspect flees on foot through the woods following an assault. An officer investigates a local bar.
The boat unit contends with an unruly suspect and his equally unpredictable dogs.
An officer makes an arrest after pulling over a vehicle transporting a sizable bag of marijuana.
